features: Automatic Heats exposes the same Registration Desk entry point used by the normal Heats workflow with Copy Link, Open Desk and live registration status
Competitors and bibs remain managed by the existing Registration Desk with no separate Automatic registration flow
Automatic Judge Scores admin-entry UI is replaced by Judge Live Scoring with secure judge browser links and live progress
Judge link sharing includes Copy, WhatsApp, Email and Open plus Submit & Lock and Super Admin audited unlock
Automatic Judge Panel starts with 3 judges and supports unlimited additional judges
Saved Rounds retains Manual/Automatic mode colour coding and mode-preserving Open links
Manual scoring, scoring calculations, Relative Placement, points logic and Release Manager workflow remain unchanged
